data.description: One geometric/functional Carrera 124/132 track piece type — the unit solvers, inventories, and layouts reason in. Distinct from Product (retail SKU): the same piece type is sold in several pack sizes and kits. Identity test: two pieces are the same PieceType iff geometrically and functionally interchangeable in a layout (banked and flat curves of the same radius are DIFFERENT types). Assert your inventory about these things cross-repo (Holding shape); per-source dimension evidence lives in SpecClaim assertions here.

kind.description: straight | curve | curve-banked | special | digital | border | accessory

lengthMm.description: Centerline length for straight-footprint pieces; null for curves and non-track accessories

radiusMm.description: Centerline radius for curves — adjudicated exact-nesting value (r1 297 / r2 495 / r3 693 / r4 891); edge radii are ±99 mm. Do NOT use rounded marketing radii (20/40 cm etc.) for geometry

solverReady.description: true = geometry sufficient for closure computation; false = piece exists but its transform is not yet verified (banked, turnouts, hairpin)

geometryBasis.description: Rationale for the adjudicated dimensions; evidence detail is in SpecClaim assertions about this thing

data.description: A purchasable Carrera retail SKU: piece pack, kit, extension set, starter set, or accessory. Box contents are ProductContent assertions about Pair[Product, PieceType]. A Product with no ProductContent has unresolved contents — that is explicit, never guessed. status changes are revisions; names never change.

partNumber.description: Common 5-digit article number; mirrors the name suffix

skuAliases.description: Other identifiers for the same product (full 8-digit SKU 200xxxxx, legacy numbers). Never separate Products

status.description: current | discontinued — discontinued products stay: inventories reference them

notes.description: Caveats, e.g. unresolved contents, non-track box items

data.description: Quantity of a PieceType inside a Product. about = Pair (ordered: Product first, PieceType second). Query from either endpoint needs resolveCollections:true. Counts are individual pieces, never packs — anti-inference: one Product 20509 contains FOUR standard straights.

quantity.description: Individual pieces of this type in the box

verified.description: false = contents not confirmed against an official source yet; unresolved stays unresolved

data.description: Grounding layer: what one source published/measured about a PieceType's geometry, in the source's own language — evidence, not truth. Conflicting claims coexist (conflict is knowledge); the adjudicated value lives on the PieceType with geometryBasis rationale. about = the PieceType.

sourceKind.description: official-product-page | official-pdf | retailer-tech-page | community-cad | community-forum | own-measurement | derived-geometrically

radiusInnerEdgeMm.description: Claimed inner-edge radius (marketing pages use rounded edge values)

trackWidthMm.description: Claimed track profile width (system-wide, recorded on straight/full)

slotSpacingMm.description: Claimed slot-to-slot spacing (system-wide, recorded on straight/full)

observedAt.description: ISO-8601 date we read the source (system time, not source publication time)
